title: Best dishes ever
text: Best dishes ever. I was really happy when I received my dishes their really pretty and durable the bowl is large enough for your vegetables or other side dishes plates and salad\bread dishes are plenty big enough for the big eaters my daughter loves them and asked to trade sets of corse I said No. the only con I found is trying to rest your fork or knife on the they fall into the plate and thats not a deal breaker for me.

product_metadata.title: Gibson Soho Lounge 16-Piece Square Reactive Glaze Dinnerware Set, Grey - 97558.16RM
features: WHAT’S IN THE BOX: Service for 4 that includes 4 of each of the following: 11” Dinner Plates, 8.25” Dessert Plates, 6” (31 OZ) Cereal Bowls and 12 OZ Mugs
CARE INSTRUCTIONS: beautiful grey dishes that are also dishwasher and microwave safe

STONEWARE/DOUBLE REACTIVE GLAZE: reactive refers to a technique how multiple colors within the glaze react together to create a dreamlike, vibrant quality to the colors and hues. Due to the reactive nature of the glaze, each stoneware piece is unique. The high firing temperature, thick build, and mix of all-natural clays, makes stoneware an incredibly durable material.

CONTEMPORARY DESIGN: artisanal reactive glaze featuring natural organic hues creating a modern elegance to the dinnerware set. The durable stoneware and reactive glaze make these sets difficult to scratch and break

PERFECT FOR GIFTING: beautiful colors, trend forward design, and the ability to mix and match sets makes this collection the perfect gift and holiday present for your friends and relatives. This collection is particularly popular as a wedding gift for couple’s moving into a new home together.

FAMILY OWNED: Gibson Homewares is an industry-leading producer of tabletop and housewares products based in Los Angeles, California. Family-owned for over 40 years, we’ve developed a family of brands that include Martha Stewart, Sur La Table, Crock-Pot, Babish, Spice by Tia Mowry, Kenmore, Oster, and more that thrive off relentless commitment to style, innovation, and value for our consumers around the world.
SOHO LOUNGE: forward-thinking, contemporary design that exemplifies value and quality
description: Add a stylish, contemporary plates and bowls to your table with the Gibson Soho Lounge Square 16-piece dinnerware set. If you are looking to bring a modern feel dishes to your home, this set is an excellent choice. A contemporary square stoneware shape and a stunning color design elevate any occasion and create a beautiful platform to show off your delicious meals with this plates and bowls sets. The Gibson Soho Lounge dinner set collection is available in many colors making it easy to find the right set to go with any table setting and in any kitchen. The Gibson Soho Lounge Square 16-piece dinnerware set comes with complete service for four including a dinner plates, dessert plates, bowls, and mugs, providing you with all the dishes you need for a casual dinner at home or entertaining friends. This is a great dish set for 4, 8, 12, or more as the traditional composition allows for endless possibilities. All these Soho Lounge dishes are made of durable stoneware that is both dishwasher and microwave safe. Bring the style and value of Gibson to your home today with this Soho Lounge plate set.
